## Updates now work from inside the app

- **Fixed: "Download failed - try again".** Download & Install could not download the installer
  in any earlier version. If you are on 1.6.1 or older, install this version by hand once
  (download the file for your system below). After that, updates happen inside the app.
- The app checks for a new version when it starts and shows a banner with **Update now**.
- **Windows:** Update now downloads the update, installs it with just a progress bar and
  reopens the app. Windows may ask once for permission to make changes - choose Yes.
- **macOS:** Update now downloads and opens the disk image; drag the app to Applications.
- **Linux:** Update now opens the download page.
- adb and scrcpy are part of the app, so they are updated together with it.

See [CHANGES.md](https://github.com/TonciZ/QA-Adbpad/blob/main/CHANGES.md) for details.
